name: Cloudflare Remote PostgreSQL Database MCP Server
description: Enables chatting with PostgreSQL databases through secure GitHub OAuth authentication, supporting read operations for all users and write operations for privileged users. Deployable as a production-ready remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers with automatic schema discovery and SQL injection protection.
